'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[2021 Aden bombings]]
***A [[car bomb]] kills 9 people and injures 12 others near [[Aden International Airport]]. The attack coincided with the arrival of Aden's former governor at the airport, who is unhurt. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-59109560 (BBC News)]
*Aftermath of the [[October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état]]
**Three people are killed as the [[Sudanese Armed Forces|military]] opens fire at an anti-[[coup]] protest in [[Omdurman]], bringing the total number of protesters killed since the coup to 14. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/30/sudanese-gear-up-for-nationwide-protests-against-military-coup (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Seven [[Malian Armed Forces|soldiers]] are killed in two separate attacks on patrols in [[Mourdiah]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/seven-mali-soldiers-killed-separate-convoy-attacks-army-2021-10-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Tigray Defense Forces]] say that they have captured the strategic city of [[Dessie]] and are advancing toward neighboring [[Kombolcha]] in [[Amhara Region|Amhara]]. The [[government of Ethiopia|government]] denies these claims, but residents confirm that the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force]] have completely withdrawn from Dessie. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/30/ethiopias-tigray-rebels-say-captured-strategic-town-of-dessie (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Over 160 buildings, including two churches, in the town of [[Thantlang]], [[Chin State]], have been destroyed by fires resulting from [[Tatmadaw]] shelling that occurred the previous day. [https://globalnews.ca/news/8337567/160-homes-ablaze-myanmar/ (AP via Global News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**In his speech at the [[G20]] [[2021 G20 Rome summit|summit]] in [[Rome]], [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Alberto Fernández]] says that huge debts "condemn generations" and that the "current system prioritizes speculation over the development of the peoples", while also condemning the previous administration of [[Mauricio Macri]] for accepting a [[United States dollar|$]]46 billion loan from the [[International Monetary Fund]]. [https://holanews.com/argentina-critica-en-el-g20-que-la-deuda-con-el-fmi-condena-a-generaciones/ (Hola News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 40,351 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 8.47 million. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/russia-hits-new-record-for-coronavirus-infections-1.5645196 (CTV News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] surpasses eight million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/europe/turkey-reports-23096-daily-covid-19-cases-tally-tops-8-mln20211031013904 (ANI News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
****[[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Kamala Harris]] receives a [[booster dose]] of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.axios.com/harris-gets-covid-19-booster-shot-d9be2982-adb8-4c36-a8c0-46026e39f406.html (Axios)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] reports a record 160 new community cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.1news.co.nz/2021/10/30/record-daily-high-160-new-covid-19-community-cases-in-nz/ (1 News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***The [[Philippines]] reports a record 423 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours due to reclassification of 373 cases previously listed as recoveries, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 43,044. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/philippines-logs-record-daily-covid-19-deaths-data-reclassified-2279981 (CNA)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Jersey dispute]], [[France–United Kingdom relations]]
**Last-ditch talks are held between British and French authorities as local authorities in the ports of [[Calais]] and [[Boulogne]] warn of a "disaster" if the [[French government]] goes ahead with its plan to "clog up" the [[English Channel]] and disrupt the trade and sailing of British vessels in French ports. [[British Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] said that the UK could consider "formal action" under trade agreements. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2021/oct/30/brexit-fishing-row-uk-and-france-hold-last-ditch-talks-to-avert-chaos-at-ports (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021 G20 Rome summit]]
**The 16th G20 summit begins for the first time in person after the beginning of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] with [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and [[President of the People's Republic of China|Chinese President]] [[Xi Jinping]] appearing via [[video link]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-59101218 (BBC News)]
*[[United States–European Union relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of Commerce|United States Commerce Secretary]] [[Gina Raimondo]] announces the removal of [[tariff]]s on steel and aluminum imports from the [[European Union]] that were [[First Trump tariffs|imposed]] during the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|presidency]] of [[Donald Trump]]. [[European Commissioner for Trade|European Trade Commissioner]] [[Valdis Dombrovskis]] announces that the bloc will [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] the action on U.S. imports, ending a [[trade war]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-eu-expected-announce-deal-ending-steel-aluminum-tariff-dispute-sources-say-2021-10-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Lebanon–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (United Arab Emirates)|Emirati foreign ministry]] announces that it will recall its [[diplomat]]s in [[Lebanon]] and ban [[Emiratis|Emirati citizens]] from traveling to the country "in solidarity with" [[Saudi Arabia]], which recalled its ambassador to Lebanon over "insulting" remarks about the [[Yemeni Civil War (2014-present)|war in Yemen]] made by Lebanese [[Ministry of Information (Lebanon)|information minister]] [[George Kurdahi]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/436798.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
